mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ORG_IDENTITY FROM PARTY_ORGANIZATION WHERE AND LENGTH(TRIM(ORG_IDENTITY)) > 0 ORDER BY ORG_IDENTITY
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(NF) AS NF FROM DYN_ZTDR WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(NF)) > 0 ORDER BY NF DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PARTY_ORGANIZATION WHERE AND PARTY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{partyName} || '%' ESCAPE '\'

SELECT ID, PARTY_NAME, ORG_IDENTITY, ATTRIBUTE_02, ATTRIBUTE_03, CREATED_DATE FROM ( SELECT ID, PARTY_NAME, ORG_IDENTITY, ATTRIBUTE_02, ATTRIBUTE_03, TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TREE_SORTS, TREE_SORT, ID) AS RN FROM PARTY_ORGANIZATION WHERE AND PARTY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{partyName} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ) WHERE RN > #{offset} AND RN <= #{limit} ORDER BY RN

SELECT ID, FK_CLO_ID, DATA_5, TO_CHAR(DATA_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PLANNED_DATE, TO_CHAR(DATA_7, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ACTUAL_DATE, DATA_12, DATA_13, WCQK, XH FROM DYN_ZZDR_INFO WHERE FK_CLO_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY DATA_4, XH, ID
